question: Approve the Paseo FO roster + conversation view POC outcome, scope, non-goals, budget and stop condition for implementation?

artifacts.summary: POC: one Paseo plugin with a roster screen (agents by role/repo/task labels, peer lookup) and a conversation view (agent-to-agent messages from the 0.12 envelope, both directions, Captain messages excluded). Stop if the plugin API cannot read cross-agent messages without polling every timeline.
